title: News reviewed: 12 item(s)
body:
- licensing LICENSE.md.tmpl changed (doc:licensing/LICENSE.md.tmpl): no effect here: Taken in: extends.toml pins release 2026.10.6 and `tend baseline render --write` rendered LICENSE.md (funding limit, provisional wording, DCO note) and bindings/python's license files.
- licensing agreements/commercial.md changed (doc:licensing/agreements/commercial.md): no effect here: Rendered privately when an agreement is made, never into this repo; nothing here to change.
- licensing combos.toml changed (doc:licensing/combos.toml): no effect here: Taken in by the 2026.10.6 render; tend check's license rules hold.
- licensing contributing.md changed (doc:licensing/contributing.md): no effect here: Taken in by the 2026.10.6 render (LICENSE.md's Contributing section).
- licensing texts/commercial.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/commercial.md): no effect here: Taken in by the 2026.10.6 render (LICENSES/LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0.txt and the bindings' copy).
- licensing texts/open-project-exception.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/open-project-exception.md): no effect here: Taken in by the 2026.10.6 render (LICENSES/AdditionRef-Open-Project-Exception-1.0.txt and the bindings' copy).
- licensing texts/royalty-free.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/royalty-free.md): no effect here: Taken in by the 2026.10.6 render (LICENSES/LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0.txt and the bindings' copy).
- the license rules changed (toolbox:licenses): no effect here: tend check after the render: 10 baseline rules hold, 0 errors; no dependency blocked by the changed license rules.
- autodyne finished milestones 4 (lanes M2 to lanes M1) (progress:autodyne/milestone:lanes M1): no effect here: autodyne's own milestones, closed by the user in this repo.
- Jacquard finished milestones 2 (M0 Scaffold to M4 Input bumps) (progress:Jacquard/milestone:M4 Input bumps): no effect here: Jacquard's milestones; autodyne uses nothing from it.
- Tend finished milestones 3 (D1 Documents to Control station) (progress:Tend/milestone:Control station): no effect here: Tend's milestones; the one autodyne todo waiting on tend (CI check) waits on its public releases, not these.
- Weft finished milestones 10 (M2 Semantics to v1.0) (progress:Weft/milestone:v1.0): no effect here: Weft's milestones; autodyne uses nothing from it.
